qualifier: via ROBO, netrin and ephrin receptors
name: Axon guidance via ROBO, netrin and ephrin receptors
rationale: All members concern growth-cone guidance and its Rho-GTPase effectors, centred on SLIT-ROBO midline, netrin/DCC, ephrin and L1 cues, whereas the main confusable adds semaphorin-plexin, regeneration and sprouting terms.

name: Regulation of respiratory burst superoxide generation
rationale: All three members regulate the phagocyte respiratory burst / superoxide production, unlike confusables about antimicrobial killing, fungal sensing or neutrophil degranulation.

name: Leptin-regulated appetite and organismal growth
rationale: Members cover leptin signaling, appetite/feeding and organism growth, distinguishing the theme from ghrelin-, prolactin- and GPCR-hormone-based feeding confusables.

name: Monocyte surface identity, activation and recruitment
rationale: Members describe monocyte surface signatures, differentiation, activation, aggregation, chemotaxis and extravasation, whereas confusables emphasise broader myeloid modules or macrophage chemotaxis and inflammatory cytokines.

core: Epithelial cell migration and cell-matrix adhesion control
name: Keratinocyte and epithelial migration via cell-matrix adhesion control
rationale: Members regulate epithelial, keratinocyte and fibroblast migration through Rho/Rac, lamellipodia, focal adhesion and matrix turnover, and the wound-spreading, EGF and invadopodia terms separate it from leading-edge actin confusables.

core: Outflow tract and great artery morphogenesis
name: Outflow tract and pharyngeal arch artery morphogenesis
rationale: All members describe cardiac neural crest-dependent outflow tract septation and pharyngeal arch/pulmonary artery formation, distinct from endothelial differentiation, heart-field and pharyngeal organ confusables.

name: Reelin signaling in dendritic spine maintenance and amyloid-tau pathology
rationale: Members link Reelin signaling and dendrite/spine maintenance with amyloid-beta and neurofibrillary tangle regulation, which the plasticity, microglia and synaptic transmission confusables lack.

name: GPCR second messenger signaling via cAMP and phosphoinositides
rationale: Members cover cAMP synthesis/degradation and PLC/inositol phosphate generation downstream of G protein-coupled receptors, the phosphoinositide arm distinguishing it from the adrenergic and PKA-focused confusables.

core: Cellular response to drugs and toxicants
name: Cellular response to drugs, anesthetics and chemical toxicants
rationale: Members are responses to exogenous chemicals (nicotine, ethanol, ether, anesthetics, cisplatin, bleomycin, bisphenol A, antibiotics), unlike confusables centred on oxidative stress, UV or amine metabolism.

name: Lung branching growth and trachea formation
rationale: Members concern lung bud branching, lobe and vascular growth plus trachea and tracheal cartilage formation, the tracheal terms separating it from mesenchyme and alveolar/surfactant confusables.

name: Ionotropic glutamate receptor activation and presynaptic G-protein channel modulation
rationale: Members are AMPA and kainate receptor activation together with Gbeta/gamma gating of calcium and potassium channels at the presynapse, while confusables share only the presynaptic part and add nicotinic or GABAergic terms.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase fusion signaling
name: Oncogenic PDGFRA/B mutant and kinase fusion signaling
rationale: All members are signaling by cancer-associated mutant or fusion receptor kinases centred on PDGFRA/B (plus FLT3 and cytosolic FGFR1 fusions), whereas confusables centre on FGFR amplification/fusions, ALK/LTK or FLT3-ITD.

core: Regulation of sodium and potassium transport
name: Regulation of plasma membrane sodium-potassium transport
rationale: All three members regulate Na+ export/transport and K+ import across the plasma membrane, unlike confusables about osmotic responses, ion homeostasis or Na/Ca exchange.

name: Axon-glia myelination and nodal domain organization
rationale: Members span CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, glial responses, axon caliber and node/paranode assembly with sodium channel clustering, the nodal terms distinguishing it from axon regeneration and L1-signaling confusables.

name: Adiponectin and insulin regulation of glucose import
rationale: Members link adiponectin secretion/signaling and insulin responsiveness to cellular glucose import, separating it from GLUT4 trafficking, insulin receptor and fatty acid uptake confusables.

name: Xenobiotic metabolism with ethanol and aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members cover xenobiotic, toxin and steroid biotransformation, and the ethanol oxidation and aldehyde detoxification terms distinguish it from confusables focused on CYP/FMO and phytochemical metabolism.

qualifier: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and B cell receptor
name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis and B cell receptor signaling
rationale: Members are activating Fc-gamma receptor phagocytic signaling and BCR second-messenger signaling via BTK/PLC, unlike confusables on inhibitory Fc signaling, Fc-epsilon/mast cell or CD22 regulation.

name: Aldosterone biosynthesis and secretion
rationale: All members concern mineralocorticoid (aldosterone) synthesis, metabolism and secretion, whereas confusables cover renin-angiotensin blood pressure control or downstream renal sodium transport.

name: APC/C-Cdc20 control of metaphase-anaphase transition and mitotic exit
rationale: Members describe APC/C-Cdc20 activity, its inhibition and substrate degradation driving anaphase onset and mitotic exit, distinct from APC/C-Cdh1, spindle checkpoint and cytokinesis confusables.

name: AKT signaling and p53 control of G2/M progression
rationale: Members combine AKT/PI3K signaling with p53 phosphorylation/degradation and CDK, Cdc25A, MASTL and GTSE1 control of G2/M, the AKT terms separating it from DNA damage checkpoint confusables.

name: Ghrelin-regulated feeding behavior and nutrient response
rationale: Members cover ghrelin production, eating behavior, food intake reduction and prolactin secretion, distinguishing it from leptin-based appetite and orexin/sleep confusables.

name: Type I interferon-stimulated antiviral gene response
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha/type I IFN response signatures and ISG effectors (OAS, ISG15, IP-10), whereas confusables centre on RIG-I/cGAS/TLR sensing and IFN induction.

name: IL-6 family gp130 cytokine signaling via STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members cover IL-6, IL-11, CNTF and LIF receptor signaling through STAT3 and ERK1/2, distinguishing it from IL-2/IL-7/STAT5 and EPO/FLT3 confusables.

name: NGF production and signaling via TRKA and p75NTR
rationale: Members span NGF processing/production, TRKA activation and proximal effectors, and proNGF-p75NTR binding, while confusables are TRK downstream cascades or p75NTR death signaling alone.

name: MECP2-regulated neuronal transcription and sensorimotor behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 (Rett) transcriptional regulation with locomotor, sensory, vocal and social behaviors and related neural development, unlike confusables centred on hindbrain development or synaptic transmission.
